as_told.title: 1952 Washington DC flyover and a living witness

plain: This story is about a wave of UFO sightings over Washington, D.C., the US capital, in July 1952. The podcast host Jesse Michels describes it several times as an overwhelming series of sightings, with saucers seen all around the city and newspaper headlines like "saucers on the White House lawn." He says President Harry Truman called Edward J. Ruppelt, then the head of the Air Force's UFO investigations, about it, and that it sent the CIA, the main US spy agency, into a frenzy over how to handle the UFO problem. Karl Nell, a former government official, tells it on the same podcast. He says the objects were seen both by eye and on radar over two weekends, that military jets went up to intercept them, and that it led to the largest press conference since the Second World War. Michels also says he recently met one of the last living witnesses in person. If true, it would mean unknown objects flew over the nation's capital in plain view of the government.
